scope: Selected exclusive main-thread sample windows. Different phases and workloads are not added or treated as a matched share comparison.

productionImageEquivalence.scope: Frozen production implementation reproduces the exact previously measured prototype images. The eight LLDB outcomes and hardware-counter observations therefore apply to these same bytes; this does not replace compiler stage-image validation.

nativePrototypeCounters.scope: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V4 instruction/cycle and user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.

manifest.scope: Same verified closed IR; no allocations or safepoints. Foreign wrapper creates a descriptor-tagged immutable stack record. Both images retain checked property reads and one direct call per iteration.
